greeting: Chronos Past on comms. Stage 2: The Fractured Guardian. Keep formation tight and decisions tighter.
We are running Against Time. Objective drift gets teams buried.
A pigeon outranked three commanders here last week. Merit system is broken.
Action first, panic never. Start with: Speak with Chronos Past.
dialog.quest_hook: Objective stack: Speak with Chronos Past; Speak with Chronos Present; Speak with Chronos Future. Keep route integrity while pressure escalates.
dialog.quest_active: Active pressure: Meet the three aspects of the Chronos Guardian. Immediate move: Speak with Chronos Past.
dialog.quest_complete: Stage 2 resolved: The Fractured Guardian. Primary objective secured and route stabilized. Prepare for Healing the Flow.
rumor: A tea stall serves the same cup twice and charges only once if you notice.
People keep repeating one clue from The Fractured Guardian: 'Speak with Chronos Future'.
The compass spun, laughed, and still pointed exactly where we needed to go.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn loops are usually stable. Mark your path or the street will rearrange you.
dialog.time_noon: Noon produces the most timeline echoes. Do not chase every duplicate signal.
dialog.time_dusk: Dusk is paradox weather. If a clock runs backward, leave it alone.
dialog.time_night: Night splits voices from bodies. Use call-and-response to track your team.

party_reactions.kade: Chronos Past sounds intense, but the plan is solid. We keep moving.
party_reactions.nix7: Tactical profile for Chronos Past accepted. Probability of success improves with compliance.
party_reactions.twist: Chronos Past talks scary, but I like it. We punch the problem and then celebrate.

relationship_dialog.stranger: State your objective in one sentence.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Welcome back. What changed since last pass?
relationship_dialog.friend: Good. We move cleaner when we move together.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: No masks, no theater, just us and the objective.
